newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV helps Austrian stocks end on highs.
newsitem.headline: OMV helps Austrian stocks end on highs.

text.p: Austria's ATX index ended almost three percent higher on Tuesday helped by "stunningly good" first half earnings from market heavyweight OMV AG.
Taking heart from Wall Street's 108-point rebound overnight, the ATX index ended 39.78 points up at 1,389.56, just off its intra-day high.

Traders said oil and chemicals group OMV, which earlier beat expectations with a 105 percent rise in earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) to 3.11 billion schillings, accounted for about 15 points of the index rise.
OMV, whose net profits were hit by a 658 million schilling extraordinary restructuring charge, saw its shares surge to end 106.3 schillings -- or 6.42 percent -- higher at 1,761.1 in brisk trade.

Although few strategists expect U.S. interest rates to be altered at Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting, Austrian dealers said trade remained nervous and volatility, following sharp falls on Monday, might continue.
Creditanstalt-Bankverein preferred shares clocked up the day's greatest gain after traders reported talk of switching into the stock from Bank Austria.
September ATX futures closed 43 points firmer at 1,395 with 2,129 contracts traded.
